comparison.objective: Reassemble and dock a cleaned nebulizer kit; candidate screens a parts/media mixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Multiple keyed insertions, push-fits, twist-locking, and hose handling versus pouring and aperture-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: All fittings attached and kit upright/released versus media recovered, washers retained, and screen released on supports.
comparison.reason: Assembly of discrete fittings does not test size-selective screening.
